Under The Shade Safari Lodge is a small boutique hotel located on the outskirts of Arusha, 2 kilometres south of the domestic airport of Arusha. It’s surrounded by a beautifully landscaped garden that is home to lush vegetation and old trees and offers chalets with a total of 12 rooms in single, double, triple and quadruple categories. There is also one family chalet, boasting 2 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, a lounge and living area, a dining table, a balcony overlooking the garden, a patio and a private pool. The rooms come with good beds with mosquito netting, an ensuite bathroom, and a living area. Free WiFi is available throughout the property.
The lodge’s restaurant has a gazebo for alfresco dining in the flower garden. You can also enjoy your meal from your patio by ordering room service. And if you want to take a dip after a long safari day, the lodge has two swimming pools, including one especially for children!
blocks.html:
On the outskirts of Arusha, 2 kilometres south of Arusha's domestic airport, you find Under The Shade Safari Lodge, a small boutique hotel. A beautifully landscaped garden full of lush plants and old trees surrounds the chalets, which hold 12 rooms in total, in single, double, triple and quadruple categories. It’s also possible to stay in the one family chalet, which has 2 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, a lounge and living area, a dining table, a balcony with a view of the garden, a patio and a private pool. Each room has good beds with mosquito nets, an ensuite bathroom and a living area. WiFi is free across the whole property.
For eating outdoors in the flower garden, the lodge’s restaurant has a gazebo. If you prefer, you can order room service and have your meal on your patio. Fancy a swim after a long day on safari? There are two swimming pools at the lodge, one of them specially for children!
